name: renda-extra-cupuns
description: Bot automatizado que monitora ofertas no WhatsApp e publica no Telegram com links de afiliado

scripts.build: prisma generate && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/generated', 'web/src/generated', {recursive:true, force:true});" && tsc
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src = 'config/.env'; const dst = 'dist/config/.env'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/config', {recursive:true}); const ex = fs.existsSync('config/.env.example') ? 'config/.env.example' : (fs.existsSync('.env.example') ? '.env.example' : null); if (ex) fs.cpSync(ex, dst, {force:true}); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.cpSync(src, dst, {force:true}); } fs.mkdirSync('dist/data', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/logs', {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Build copiado para dist/');"
